comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The switch position names are read verbatim from Stargazer::Stargazer: Filter Mode is Lowpass, Bandpass, Notch, Highpass, Off; the LFO waveshapes are Sine, Triangle, Ramp Up, Ramp Down, Square, Stepped Random, Smooth Random; the LFO ranges are Slow, Medium, Fast; the sub oscillator switch is Off and On. The wavetable selector is configured 1 to 88. Stargazer::process is six thousand instructions long and was not read through, so no frequency, depth or rate figures are quoted; the control lines say what each control is for, from the maker's own parameter names and the words on the panel. Two CV jacks were tagged to each other's line: ALIAS CV is index 8 and drives the sample rate reducer, REDUX CV is index 9 and drives the bit depth, and the tags are now the right way round. REDUX CV replaces its knob rather than adding to it, so the knob is dead while a cable is in. Four jacks are normalled to an LFO when nothing is patched: FM CV and FREQ 2 CV to LFO 3 at a fifth of its level, WAVE CV to LFO 1.
